entities.summary: Lars Widenfalk is a Swedish artist who works as a sculptor in Sweden, the Czech Republic and Italy. He is considered to have helped renewed figurative expression in Nordic sculpture. He works with many materials, from bronze, snow and ice. But his main material is stone, usually marble and granite. In recent years, he has also worked with glass. He is married to the Czech artist Alena Matejka. Widenfalk's sculptures evoke a sense of awe and wonder, inviting viewers to explore the harmonious relationship between humanity and the natural world.
